name: New Dudhi Powder 100gm – Acts as Liver tonic
original_description:
Dudhi Powder – Acts as Liver tonic and help in lowering lipid levels.

Zaarah Herbals Dudhi Powder has a lot of fibre, vitamin C, riboflavin, zinc, thiamine, iron, magnesium, manganese, and other nutrients. Dudhi (bottle gourd) is grown organically in the pollution-free Sahyadri mountain region and organically processed according to Indian standards. It is a liver tonic and can help decrease lipid levels. Zaarah Herbals 100% Dudhi Powder may aid in the reduction of lipid levels. It may also be effective against acidity and liver tonic. Dudhi is a fantastic liver tonic.

Dudhi (Bottle gourd) is high in dietary fiber, Vitamin C, Riboflavin, Zinc, Thiamine , Iron , Magnesium , Manganese etc. Dudhi (Bottle gourd) is Organically Grown at the Pollution free Sahyadri Mountain range and Certified Organically Processed as per Indian Standard (NPOPJ).

Benefits of Dudhi Powder – Acts as Liver tonic

  • May help in lowering lipid levels.
  • Dudhi acts as an excellent Liver tonic.
  • May work well against acidity.
  • Helpful in improving bowel movements.

Direction for use: Take 3 gms powder, 1 to 2 times a day
